shortIntro.title: Is Your Phone Ready for Farlight 84? 🚀📱
shortIntro.para1: Farlight 84 isn’t just another battle royale. It mixes jetpacks, hero abilities, vehicles, and chaotic squad fights into one fast-paced survival experience.
shortIntro.para2: Quick dashes, smooth recoil control, and clean ability timing demand stable FPS. If your phone struggles, you’ll feel the lag before you even see the enemy 😅🔥.

intro: Below are the updated minimum and recommended device requirements for running Farlight 84 smoothly on Android and iOS — whether you’re pushing ranked or just vibing with your squad 🚀.

minimum.CPU: Snapdragon 660 / Helio G70 level or equivalent
minimum.Internet: Stable 4G or Wi-Fi connection – packet loss = instant defeat 💀

recommended.Storage: 5GB+ free for smooth updates and assets
recommended.Internet: Strong Wi-Fi or 5G for competitive play

ios_intro: On iOS, Farlight 84 feels extremely optimized 🍎✨. Animations stay fluid, jetpack boosts respond instantly, and firefights remain smooth even during heavy explosions.

ios_recommended.title: Storage
ios_recommended.value: 5GB+ free space for long-term smooth gameplay

fps_intro: Frame rate is everything in Farlight 84. Faster FPS means cleaner tracking, smoother jetpack movement, and better reaction time ⚡.
settings_intro: Optimizing graphics settings can dramatically improve performance — sometimes more than upgrading hardware 🎯.

low_end.title: Frame Rate
low_end.value: Standard or High (avoid Max on weak devices)

low_end.title: Shadows & Effects
low_end.value: Turn off advanced shadows and bloom

low_end.title: Background Apps
low_end.value: Close unused apps to free RAM

high_end.title: Graphics Quality
high_end.value: High or Ultra for sharp visuals ✨

high_end.title: Frame Rate
high_end.value: Enable Max FPS for competitive edge

high_end.title: Thermal Control
high_end.value: Use cooling or avoid charging while playing 🔥

high_end.title: Free Storage
high_end.value: Keep extra 2–3GB free for smoother loading

faqIntroText: Common Farlight 84 questions — answered clearly and simply 😎:

faqList.question: Can Farlight 84 run on 3GB RAM phones?
faqList.answer: Yes, but only on low settings. Expect occasional frame drops during intense battles.

faqList.question: Does Farlight 84 support high FPS mode?
faqList.answer: Yes. Many mid-range and flagship devices support 60 FPS and above.

faqList.question: Why does my phone heat up while playing?
faqList.answer: Jetpack mechanics, large maps, and continuous action stress the CPU and GPU. Playing in a cool environment helps reduce throttling.
